tools.description: Starts a domain purchase on the owner's saved card. ALWAYS returns confirm_required first: RELAY the question to the human VERBATIM and call confirm_purchase only after they say yes (a spoken yes counts). Pass site_ref to bundle buy+connect into that ONE yes. Returns { order_id, confirm_required, confirm_token, question, speak }. WARNING: real money once confirmed — never invent your own question.
tools.name: buy_domain

tools.description: Completes a purchase AFTER the human said yes to the exact question from buy_domain. Returns { order_id, state, speak, state_proof, next_actions }. The charge happens here — only call with a real yes.
tools.name: confirm_purchase

tools.description: The full knob list of this service with trust tiers — how a brand-new agent learns what it can do here. Returns the capabilities manifest. SAFE TO RUN; also served at /.well-known/windy-capabilities.json.
tools.name: get_capabilities

tools.description: The answer to "what domains do I own?". Returns { domains: [{fqdn, status, auto_renew, expires_at, speak}], speak }.
tools.name: list_my_domains

tools.description: Deep repair: re-renders and re-applies the newest DNS intent for a domain you own (desired-state, safe to repeat). Use when a site stopped resolving. Gold+ Eternitas standing required. Returns { fqdn, intent, applied, speak, state_proof }.
tools.name: repair_dns

tools.description: Deep repair: re-reads the registrar's facts for a domain you own and reconciles our records (status, registration). Safe to repeat. Gold+ standing required. Returns { fqdn, registrar_known, status, speak }.
tools.name: resync_domain

tools.description: Windy Doctor for the domains service — use FIRST when anything seems wrong. Returns { checks: [{status, severity, finding, remediation}] } where remediation is a LITERAL tool call to make next. SAFE TO RUN.
tools.name: run_diagnostics

tools.description: The answer to "is grandmarose.com taken?" — checks one exact name. Returns { fqdn, available, price_cents?, price_pending?, speak }. SAFE TO RUN anytime; charges nothing.
tools.name: search_domains

tools.description: Turns yearly auto-renew on or off for a domain. ALWAYS returns confirm_required first: RELAY the question VERBATIM — turning renewal OFF can silently lose the domain a year later, so the human must say yes. Returns { fqdn, auto_renew, speak } once confirmed.
tools.name: set_auto_renew

tools.description: The answer to "what should we call it?" — brainstorms available names from personal hints (a granddaughter's name, a nickname, a business word). Pass 1-8 short hints from YOUR conversation; they are never stored. Returns { suggestions: [{fqdn, price_cents, speak}], speak }.
tools.name: suggest_domains
